relationships.subject: AdVEGF-D gene therapy
relationships.evidence_quote: Angina symptoms (CCS) were less severe compared to baseline in VEGF-D group (1.9 vs. 2.9; P = 0.006) but not in control group (2.2 vs. 2.6; P = 0.414).

relationships.subject: VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: The aim of this treatment is to induce the formation of new blood vessels (angiogenesis) and vasodilation of the existing vessels (arteriogenesis) by increasing the expression of VEGFs [3, 4].

key_findings: Eight-year follow-up of phase I KAT301 found no safety concerns with intramyocardial AdVEGF-D gene therapy versus control (MACE HR 0.97).
Angina severity (CCS) remained lower than baseline in the VEGF-D group but not controls; small sample and PCI confound interpretation.
